content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Clarksville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of equivalent experience. Review your education and work history against PMI's criteria. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help clarify whether your background qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend all required sessions from your Clarksville location on a schedule that fits your work commitments. You'll receive instruction, case studies, and direct interaction with instructors—all online, all designed to prepare you for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, providing proof of your education, experience, and contact hours. Pay the exam fee at that time. PMI will review your submission; most candidates receive approval within one to two weeks.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to reinforce course material. Schedule your computer-based exam at a local testing center or via remote proctoring. The PMP exam tests your mastery of project-management domains and your readiness to lead.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll earn your PMP designation valid for three years. Maintain it by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, or work experience. PMI's flexible renewal process keeps your credential current and your knowledge aligned with industry standards.
